description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments  - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about parcel numbers, cadastral maps, land ownership transfers, and corrections to land title records for specific properties in Homagama, Colombo District. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
